source.method: Holes, greens, tees, bunkers and water from OpenStreetMap (API 0.6 map call, Oct 3 2026). Village and Mill hole lines re-routed down the turf corridor seen in aerial imagery (least-cost path tee to green over a turf/tree mask, kept near the OSM line and off neighbouring holes; Village 1 placed by hand). Woods (natural=wood) and fairways (golf=fairway, the turf corridor eroded 8 m) segmented automatically from the imagery within 75 m / 45 m of the hole lines. School hole lines are OSM as drawn.
source.imagery: Esri World Imagery z18 (~0.5 m/px), dormant-turf capture
source.caveat: Automatic segmentation, not a survey: tree edges within a few yards; shade on turf can read as trees; no OB.
